name: polyglot
title: Polyglot
description: Bilingual RU⇄EN translator (OpenAI or Gemini) that detects the direction itself and streams a learning breakdown, plus in-place proofreading (casual and formal) for the selected text in any app
author: makarurbanov

commands.name: translate
commands.title: Translate
commands.subtitle: Polyglot
commands.description: Translate RU⇄EN with automatic direction and an explanation block — streamed, all at once, or on demand

preferences.name: explanationLanguage
preferences.title: Explanation Language
preferences.description: Language of the explanation block (e.g. Russian, English, German)

preferences.name: alwaysExplain
preferences.title: Always Explain
preferences.label: Always show the explanation block
preferences.description: Force the block even for simple, unambiguous phrases (overrides the automatic display rules). Applies to the Stream and All at once modes; On demand always explains when asked.

preferences.name: explanationMode
preferences.title: Explanation Mode
preferences.description: How the explanation block arrives. Stream: the translation appears as soon as it streams, the explanation streams in below it. All at once: wait for the full result. On demand: translation only; press Enter on the result to generate the explanation.

data.title: All at once (wait for the full result)

commands.name: proofread
commands.title: Proofread
commands.subtitle: Polyglot
commands.description: Fix grammar, spelling, punctuation and awkward word order in the selected text, in place — keeps your wording and tone

commands.name: proofread-formal
commands.title: Proofread Formal
commands.subtitle: Polyglot
commands.description: Rewrite the selected text into a polished formal register, in place

preferences.name: provider
preferences.title: Provider
preferences.description: Which service runs Translate and Proofread. Both keys can be stored; this switch picks the active one.

preferences.name: openaiApiKey
preferences.title: OpenAI API Key
preferences.description: Used when Provider = OpenAI. Create one at platform.openai.com/api-keys (paid API usage)

preferences.name: openaiModel
preferences.title: OpenAI Model
preferences.description: Used when Provider = OpenAI. OpenAI model ID; must accept reasoning effort "none". Default gpt-6-luna

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: Gemini API Key
preferences.description: Used when Provider = Gemini. Free key — aistudio.google.com → Get API key (free tier)

preferences.name: model
preferences.title: Gemini Model
preferences.description: Used when Provider = Gemini. Gemini model ID. Default gemini-2.5-flash. Free tier: gemini-2.5-flash, gemini-2.5-flash-lite, gemini-3.5-flash

preferences.name: outputLanguage
preferences.title: Proofread Output Language
preferences.description: Proofread commands only. "auto" keeps each text's own language; a language name (e.g. English) makes Proofread always produce that language — translating the text into it when needed.

preferences.name: pasteMode
preferences.title: Paste Mode
preferences.description: Proofread commands only: how the corrected text replaces your selection. Plain (match style) avoids the extra blank lines Teams/Slack add on a rich paste; needs Accessibility permission for Raycast.
